document.name: RerenderFixture
document.documentation:
Non-persistent Kitchen Sink fixture for a field whose change and blur handlers both rerender the view.
Leaving Typed Text runs both handlers. The server counts the rerenders it is sent for Typed Text, per fixture, outside the conversation (RerenderFixtureBizlet), so that two requests sent at once are counted as two even though the conversation keeps only the last one's changes. Show Rerender Count copies the count into Rerender Count.

text.name: typed
text.description: Leaving it after a change runs its change handler and its blur handler, each of which rerenders the view.

integer.name: rerenderCount
integer.description: The number of rerenders the server was sent for Typed Text, as Show Rerender Count last read it.
